newsitem.title: USA: CV Therapeutics sets IPO terms at $27.5 million.
newsitem.headline: CV Therapeutics sets IPO terms at $27.5 million.

text.p: Biopharmaceutical company CV Therapeutics Inc set terms for its planned initial public offering at about $27.5 million.
The company filed for an offering of 2.5 million shares to price in a range of $12 to $14 a share, according to a document filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday.

CV develops "small molecule" drugs to treat chronic cardiovascular disease. Lead underwriter JP Morgan said the IPO is due sometime in late October. The shares would trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "CVTX".
